name: THE HOUR OF CREATION
desc:
⏰ You don't have much time. The animatronics are looking for you. Complete the objectives before they find you...

⚠️ Warning: This game contains flashing lights, jumpscares, and other horror elements.

👥 Play with up to 4 in a party, or up to 8 with a gamepass!
👍 Like the game and join the group for extra rewards!
🎧 Use headphones for a better experience.

🎮 Controls: 
Flashlight - F 
Sprint - LShift
Crouch - C

🍕 Thanks to Scott Cawthon for the Five Nights at Freddy's games as well as Nikson for The Joy of Creation!

TAGS: FNAF, TJOC, The Joy of Creation, Freddy, Freddy Fazbear, Ignited, Bonnie, Chica, Foxy, Golden Freddy, Eternal Nights, Co-op
